review_type: independent AI editorial review of eight new A2 speaking items

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind per-item findings were written to content/reviews/095-review.md from the source-only packet (hash 8e8fdbc3a4ed0c474b5a6f967552cade3e8c39a30450940cacc760f481d18145) before criteria, samples, models, starters or notes were opened. tone_balance.scope_note: All eight tasks are ordinary everyday scenes; the plan allows at most one lightly humorous speaking item per batch and none was needed. The coordinator checks the combined A2 count.

edits.reason: The starter told the learner that a husband is in the picture and so partly supplied the 'two things the family does' criterion; the new frame names no person.

checks.batch_check: npx tsx scripts/batch-check.ts content/batches/095-proposed.json: 8 items, 0 failures; one warning (slug 'ouderavond' also used by B1 reading batch003, a different part and topic: accepted).
checks.word_gate: No unlisted words or compounds were reported in prompts, cues, criteria, models, alts or starters; herkennen, balie, id-kaart, pasfoto, geldig, tweedehands are on the list and explained by the scene.
checks.open_task_contract: pass: every printed prompt (video: cue plus prompt) asks for each hidden criterion; counts ('twee') appear in the prompt; both picture-choose prompts end with 'Zeg ook iets over het andere plaatje.'; one null quote per sample; quotes verbatim; models 40-43 words; speakingSeconds 40, prepSeconds 10.
checks.names: Six names, each in one item; no voice name or old cast name.

diversity.within_batch: Eight different domains and purposes (route giving, desk visit, school talk, beach day, GP booking, bike purchase, birthday, library).
diversity.set_assembly: Keep the two choose items and the two sequences apart in a four-item drill only if the set is mixed; the two video-answer cues are f-older and m-young, distinct voices.

media_notes.voices: reiziger-weg cue f-older (Hanneke, spectral-v1 preset applies); baliemedewerker cue m-young (Ruben); prompts read by the narrator.
media_notes.pictures: Check at display size: used versus new bike in tweedehands-nieuw (rust, worn saddle); child's drawings on the ouderavond table; Maaike's ponytail and orange jumper and Mustafa's beard and son's curly hair consistent across panels; blank screens, no text.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Level verdicts are editorial comparisons with existing A2 items, not learner data.
No rendered media were reviewed; pictures and audio are outside this source review.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 video-answer items (e.g. the bus-stop question); slightly more demanding because directions need left/right and a landmark
level.reason: Two-part cue plus one added detail, all in main clauses; model 43 words, sentences at most 10 words.

evidence.prompt: U bent op het station van uw stad. Een vrouw met een koffer stelt u een vraag. U hoort de vraag. Geef antwoord. Zeg ook hoe zij het gemeentehuis kan herkennen.
evidence.cue: Pardon, ik ben hier niet bekend. Hoe loop ik van het station naar het gemeentehuis, en hoe lang duurt dat?

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg hoe de vrouw naar het gemeentehuis kan lopen.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: U loopt rechtdoor tot de brug. Na de brug gaat u naar rechts.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg hoe lang het lopen duurt.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Het is ongeveer tien minuten lopen.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg hoe zij het gemeentehuis kan herkennen.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Het gemeentehuis is een groot wit gebouw aan een plein.

sample.quote_check: Quote 2 is null (no duration); quotes 1 and 3 are verbatim in the sample.
sample.learner_error: verb second after a fronted phrase; missing article

evidence.starters: pass: three open frames (route, duration, building) that name no answer
evidence.title_and_cues: Title 'Een reiziger op het station' gives the setting only; the printed prompt does not repeat the cue question and asks the one extra detail.
evidence.picture_alignment: Still of one woman about 70 with a suitcase; alt reveals no answer.

meaning.situation_summary: An older woman with a small suitcase asks a stranger in the station hall of the learner's own town how to walk to the town hall and how long it takes.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Give a short route, a duration and a landmark so a visitor finds the gemeentehuis.
meaning.contrivance_check: A visitor asking a local the way from the station is routine; the learner invents the route, so no off-page fact is forced. 'hoe zij het gemeentehuis kan herkennen' is what a helper adds to directions.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken answer to the woman standing in front of the learner; the prompt says she asks a question and the learner answers her directly.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 video-answer items at a desk (e.g. the huisarts assistant question)
level.reason: Cue of 14 words in two parts, prompt asks one extra detail; model 40 words, sentences at most 10 words; the only less common words (id-kaart, pasfoto, geldig) are on the A2 list.

evidence.prompt: U bent in het gemeentehuis. U staat bij de balie. Een medewerker stelt u een vraag. U hoort de vraag. Geef antwoord. Zeg ook wat u hebt meegenomen.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg waarvoor u komt.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Ik kom voor een nieuwe id-kaart.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg of u een afspraak hebt.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Ja, ik heb een afspraak om half tien.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg wat u hebt meegenomen.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Ik heb mijn oude id-kaart en een nieuwe pasfoto meegenomen.

sample.quote_check: Quote 2 null (no word about an appointment); the others are verbatim.
sample.learner_error: missing article; participle not at the end

evidence.starters: pass: 'Ik kom voor …', 'Een afspraak heb ik …', 'Ik heb … meegenomen.' name no purpose or document
evidence.title_and_cues: Title names only the place; cue and prompt do not overlap.
evidence.picture_alignment: Still of a young man at a wide desk with a blank screen; alt reveals no answer.

meaning.situation_summary: A young gemeente employee at the counter greets a visitor and asks why they came and whether they have an appointment.
meaning.communicative_purpose: State a reason for the visit, say whether an appointment exists and name the documents brought.
meaning.contrivance_check: A first desk greeting at a town hall always asks purpose and appointment; bringing papers is a real part of such a visit and the learner chooses the purpose, so no personal data is requested.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken answer to the employee shown in the still; the learner stands at his desk, so the medium and recipient are given by the scene.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 picture-describe items (e.g. the school-yard and gym items)
level.reason: Prompt carries the three asks (see, two table objects, opinion) in short main clauses; model 41 words, all sentences at most 9 words.

evidence.prompt: Sophie heeft een zoon van zeven. Vanavond is er ouderavond op zijn school. Vertel wat u ziet. Noem twee dingen die u op de tafel ziet. Vertel ook wat u van een ouderavond vindt. Gebruik het plaatje.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Vertel wat u op het plaatje ziet.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Ik zie Sophie en de leraar in de klas.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Noem minstens twee dingen die u op de tafel ziet.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Op de tafel liggen tekeningen en een schrift.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg wat u van een ouderavond vindt.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Ik vind een ouderavond belangrijk.

sample.quote_check: Quote 2 null (only drawings, one object); quotes 1 and 3 verbatim.

evidence.starters: pass: 'Ik zie Sophie en …' repeats a name the prompt gives; 'Op de tafel zie ik … en …' leaves the objects open
evidence.title_and_cues: Title 'Ouderavond op school' repeats the prompt's occasion and names no table object.
evidence.picture_alignment: Alt keeps pictured facts (drawings, notebook, two coffees) as open-task alts must. Teacher is a man, against the role stereotype.

meaning.situation_summary: Sophie, a mother of a seven-year-old, sits with the male teacher at a small classroom table over a child's drawings, a notebook and two coffees on the evening of the ouderavond.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Describe the scene, name two table objects and give an opinion about parents' evenings.
meaning.contrivance_check: Prompt states the occasion (ouderavond for her son's school) so a parent with a teacher and drawings fits; the three table objects are all pictured, so nothing is invented.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken description to no invented recipient; prompt says 'Gebruik het plaatje' and the opinion question is about the learner's own view.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 picture-describe items
level.reason: Count 'twee' is in the prompt; model 42 words in four sentences, none over 12 words.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Chantal zit op een handdoek en leest een boek. Haar man en haar zoon spelen met een bal bij het water.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg wat u van een dag aan het strand vindt.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Een dag aan het strand vind ik heerlijk, want ik zwem graag.

sample.quote_check: Quote 3 null (no opinion); quote 2 spans two sentences, both verbatim.

evidence.starters: edited: starter 2 'Chantal … en haar man …' revealed that a husband is in the picture; now 'Het gezin … en …'
evidence.title_and_cues: Title 'Een vrije dag met het gezin' names neither place nor activity.
evidence.picture_alignment: Alt keeps the pictured facts (towel, book, ball, basket).

meaning.situation_summary: Chantal sits reading on a towel while her husband and son play ball by the water; a basket stands beside the towel on a sunny beach.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Describe the scene, name two things the family does and give an opinion about a beach day.
meaning.contrivance_check: A Saturday at the beach with a picnic basket and a ball is a normal family day; 'strand' is not given away before the opinion question, and the two activities are pictured.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken description with no invented recipient; the opinion asks the learner's own view.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 picture-choose items (e.g. phoning or visiting the gemeente)

evidence.prompt: U wilt een afspraak maken bij de huisarts. Belt u liever, of maakt u de afspraak liever online? Kies een van de plaatjes. Vertel ook waarom. Zeg ook iets over het andere plaatje.

prompt_criteria_model_alignment.criterion_nl: Zeg ook iets over het andere plaatje.
prompt_criteria_model_alignment.model_quote: Online een afspraak maken, op het tweede plaatje, is ook handig.

sample.quote_check: Quote 2 null (choice and other picture, no reason); quotes 1 and 3 verbatim.

meaning.situation_summary: The same man at the same kitchen table with a cup of tea: in one picture on the phone, in the other typing on a laptop; the learner chooses how to book a GP appointment.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Choose phoning or online, give a reason and say something about the other way.
meaning.contrivance_check: Booking with the huisarts by phone or website is a real choice; both pictures show the same person and table, differing only in the medium.

evidence.title_and_cues: Title 'Samen naar de bibliotheek' gives the place already in the prompt, no panel action.

meaning.situation_summary: On a Saturday Mustafa takes his son to the library, where a librarian gives the boy a card, then they pick picture books, and in the evening they read together on the sofa at home.
